hypotheses.evidence: T2a: T120_s20 −5.30 %/trade vs X2_trail −11.55 % (n≈400); both parts of the data agree
hypotheses.criterion: challenger T120 expectancy > current-lane X2 on the same independent entries, n ≥ 30, after costs
hypotheses.where: MOMENTUM-CHALLENGER primary vs its X2 shadow

hypotheses.statement: Creator dev buys ≥ 1 % of supply mark worse trades (tail risk), not only ≥ 10 %
hypotheses.evidence: EXTENDED "Creator dev buy": rejected n=104 −12.96 % (18 ≤ −50 %) vs kept n=57 +4.61 %; last 30 % −4.85 % vs −2.95 %
hypotheses.criterion: challenger expectancy and ≤ −50 % share better than SV4 control on the same entries

hypotheses.statement: Sizing for the exit's real stop keeps the 0.5 % per-position budget
hypotheses.evidence: X2_VS_X3: 0.0224 SOL with −20 % stop ⇒ 0.72 % modeled loss
hypotheses.criterion: no challenger loss > 0.5 % of book except gap/rug fills; report every breach
